lines: Tell me, tell me how it all works
Broken, I'm broken, in this world
It won't come undone, it won't come undone anymore, not even the truth
In this warped world I'm slowly turning transparent, fading from view
Inside a world someone else drew, I don't want to hurt you
A loneliness spreading endlessly entwines me, the memory of your innocent smile pierces me
I can't move, I can't move, I can't move, I can't move, I can't move, I can't move
It changed, and I couldn't change it
The two entwine, the two of us perish
In this warped world I'm slowly turning transparent, fading from view
Before the future comes undone in a lonely trap someone set
Don't forget me, don't forget me, don't forget me, don't forget me
A paradise full of things I can't change
